x: The 880 yards saw Bob Taylor continue his good form by winning the race in 1 min. 57.3 secs. which equalled last year's time. "Jumbo" Masters also competed, but found the pace a little too fast for him, but will do better with more experience of such races.
The handicap was won by George Stace, with "Jumbo" Masters in second place and Denis Brickwood third, and Masters ran very well seeing that this was his first appearance over the country this season.

That man out front?----Why, "Jumbo" Masters of course.The "Pied Piper of Parliament Hill" is seen here propelling that Belgrave vest to the very summit where T.V. cameras were positioned to screen their first ever "Southern".
